meta.shape: Matches astranov.eu/datanet/menus.json shops/client/driver. Extra keys are ignored by datanet/index.html seedFrom.
meta.price_rule: Only single public prices. Wolt cents converted to a 2-decimal EUR string. If a required option changes the price, only the zero-surcharge base option is stored and named in vol. Items with no single price were omitted. efood lines marked Από/from were omitted.
meta.verified_means: verified true = price read from a public Wolt menu JSON or an efood page extract in this pass. verified false = kept from the previous menus.json and not re-read.
meta.efood_blocked: A later direct fetch of e-food.gr returned HTTP 403/503. Exact efood prices below are only those visible in an earlier public page extract.
skipped: efood Ειρήνη: unnamed 2,30€ at the top of the extract, and Coca-Cola light 330ml (price not shown in the extract).
efood Rodos taste (Agios Nikolaos): Espresso, Freddo espresso, Cappuccino shown only as Από.
efood Keza cafe (Analipsi): coffees shown as Από; the 10,50€ line is a 2+2 deal, not a single item.
efood Pronto / Special: many lines shown as Από, so not copied (Wolt base prices used instead).
efood Η συνάντηση (Rodini): offer cards showed a deal price and a strikethrough together, so omitted.
efood Meet the Grill (Mandraki) and Λεβέντης: page refetch returned 403 before item prices could be read.
Wolt virtual venues (myBurger, myPasta, SMASHKI and similar) skipped.
Wolt shops clearly outside Rhodes town (Salvatore and Elias Grill, Ialysos) not included.
Paid size upgrades (for example Pronto maxi pizza) were not stored as separate prices.
